description: Agent Tax Records: submit information returns with the payment records beneath them: the information return batch with its reference, form (such as Form 1099-NEC), tax year, the payment threshold at or above which a return is issued, the filing deadline the record states, the currency and each return issued with its id, reference, payee name, payee reference, amount reported and the day issued; each payment with its id, reference, payee name, payee reference, the day paid and the amount. The signed report gives the returns and the payments, each payee paid at or above the threshold in the tax year against the returns issued, each payee’s reported amount against the payments to the payee in the tax year, each issue date against the deadline, and each return matched by payee reference against the payee name on the payments, and counts them, and names divergent information returns: a payee paid past the stated threshold with no return issued, an amount on a return that differs from the payment record, a return dated after the filing deadline, and a return issued to a payee name unlike the payment record; then a return issued to a payee the payments show nothing paid to in the tax year, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No returns, no payments, no threshold, no deadline or no tax year leaves those points unverified. Payees match by their reference where both records carry one and otherwise by their name with entity endings folded, payments count toward a payee only when paid in the tax year, and amounts compare to the cent and dates by the day. This reads whether the information returns issued and the payment records beneath them tie together, payee by payee. Verdict tax_information_return_divergent, tax_information_return_partial, tax_information_return_unverified or tax_information_return_consistent. POST /api/tax-information-return-check. Reads the tax records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it gives no tax advice, prepares or files nothing and decides nothing about anyone’s tax liability, which stay with the taxpayer and their tax professional, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Tax Records reads tax records: a filed return, tax payment records, sales tax records, withholding records, information returns, estimated payment records, deduction claims and tax authority notices, each against the books, schedules and deadline, the amounts the filed returns state as due, the stated rate and the sales tax remittances, the payroll record and the withholding remittances, the payment records, the periods and amounts the stated method sets, the support records, or the filed returns and responses it answers to. The family’s ground is the tax record set itself; the Agent Bookkeeping family reads the books the filings are drawn from, and this family reads the filings, payments and notices after they exist. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-tax-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-tax-records/.
